nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: General store. We've got what's on the shelves and opinions about everything else.

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: For the horse, I take it. Tell that bloodthirsty steed of yours Mabel says hello.

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: Cold iron. Those wind-up things at night HATE the taste of it — it'll spare your pockets exactly once, then you'll be back. They always come back.

nodes.speaker: Mabel
nodes.text: Looking's free. It's the only thing that is.
